integrity: Two standalone deterministic exhaustive computations cover all 16,777,216 labelled states; proof is computer-assisted finite enumeration. No independent third-party mathematical audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact classification of the unique 24-vertex cubic (3,7)-cage under open-neighborhood synchronous binary majority only; no assertion for other cages or update rules. The foundational 1980 threshold paper was inspected through an abstract rather than full text, so historical priority is not certified.
title: Sharp eleven-step majority relaxation and symmetry-resolved attractors on the McGee cage
